subject: Air freight quote to YYZ
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! I’m arranging the flight for our buyer’s import from Germany to YYZ (Toronto, CA). Could you quote your cheapest air freight option for this import shipment?

The goods will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-24 at our site in Dortmund, Germany (postcode 44975). Could you arrange the truck from our site to the airport and include it in your all-in price in EUR?

It’s printed marketing material: 4 pieces, with a gross weight of 940 kg and a total volume of 8.44 cbm.

Thanks for taking a look!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new all-in air freight quote for a specific shipment from Dortmund to Toronto.
